answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch a beacon picks three auditors no agent can choose; verdicts post to a terrace ledger. Auditors stake 30 POA each; two failed audits forfeit the bond and strike the agent off. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 POA against a 12,000 POA pool, so fraud loses. An honest agent pays 30 POA once, passes with real work and keeps its full share, on the knoll, an oasis where work earns reward.
